The Nanochip Assembly Complex can build all three families. It gains §lno §lnew §lmodule§r: our parts go through the modules you already have.
- Chips: the §9Cutting Chamber§r.
- Stellar SMDs: the §9Part Processor§r.
- Boards: the §9Board Processor§r.
- Circuits: the §9Assembly Matrix§r. Its Component Assembly Line casing must match the circuit's tier as for GregTech's own: UHV casing for every UHV to UIV member, UEV for the UMV ones, UIV for the UXV ones and UMV for the Omega Mainframe.

Feed it as you feed GregTech's circuits; NEI's Nanochip pages show every recipe. It uses the same EU as the Assembly Line route: the gain is throughput. Our circuits count toward no calibration.

[note]Before removing Beyond the Stars from a world, empty your Vacuum Conveyors of its components: unknown components in a saved conveyor are deleted, and the log names each one.[/note]
